title: People
steps: Create a code and share it with the other person.
They enter it in “I have a code” and pick which account receives.
Done: send each other money without it counting as an expense or income.
shareMessage: Let's link up on Genobills to send each other money without it counting as an expense or income. Open Settings › People › Link › "I have a code" and enter: {{code}}
pickReceive: Pick the account you'll receive into.
emptyTitle: You don't have any linked people yet
emptyBody: Link up with your partner or whoever you share expenses with to send each other money without it counting as an expense or income.
privacy: Each of you keeps your own accounts. Once linked, each person sees the other's name (or, if they don't have one, the part of their email before the @) and the transfers between you; nothing else from your accounts or transactions. You can unlink anytime.
pickHint: Their balance, accounts and the history of what you've sent each other show up here, next to the list.

detail.canSend: You can send each other transfers.
detail.cantSend: You can't send each other transfers anymore; your history is kept.
detail.nothingYet: You haven't sent each other anything yet. Make a transfer and pick {{name}} as the destination.
detail.receivesIn: What they send you lands in
detail.noReceive: You haven't picked where to receive yet.
detail.unlinkBody: You won't be able to send each other transfers anymore. The ones already made stay in both your accounts, and you'll still see your history here.
